title: Hype only brands last so long... it's adapt or die
description: Hype only brands last so long... it's adapt or die
transcript: Prime Hydration has gone bankrupt. Are you surprised? KSI and Logan Paul did over $1.2 billion in their first 18 months of business. All built on hype, attention, and the power of the founders personal brands. They fundamentally failed to adapt their marketing strategy. Leveraging Logan Paul and KSI at the start worked better than anyone could have imagined. They paraded it on a world tour like it was a concert, and they treated retail announcements like clothing drops. Funny enough, I've also generated over $1.2 billion for my clients in the past 11 years. Here's what they need to do. I need to transition from the hype and aggressive promotion and make the link as to why you should buy it, creating logic behind the purpose. I mean, they sponsor some of the biggest sports club on the planet and the biggest athletes and creators too. But beyond the flashy headline, they failed to show athletes actually using and benefiting from the product. That hype can only carry so much weight. It's time to adapt or die, prime.
